title: UploadFile file picker broken in Swagger UI since 0.129.1 (contentMediaType change)
body: ### First Check - [X] I added a very descriptive title here. - [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it. - [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search. - [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information. - [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer. - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc). ### Commit to Help - [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆 ### Example Code ```python from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File app = FastAPI() @app.post("/upload") async def upload(files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)): return {"count": len(files)} ``` ### Description Since FastAPI 0.129.1 (PR #14953), UploadFile fields generate contentMediaType: "application/octet-stream" instead of format: "binary" in the OpenAPI schema. Swagger UI 5.x (bundled with FastAPI via CDN @5) does not render a file picker for contentMediaType — it shows a text input instead. ### Operating System macOS ### Operating System Details _No response_ ### FastAPI Version 0.131.0 ### Pydantic Version 2.12.5 ### Python Version 3.14.2 ### Additional Context ``` from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File app = FastAPI() @app.post("/upload") async def upload(files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)): return {"count": len(files)} ``` 1. First Check

 I added a very descriptive title here.
 I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
 I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
 I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.

 I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to Pydantic.
 I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to Swagger UI.
 I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to ReDoc.

Commit to Help

 I commit to help with one of those options 👆

Example Code
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/upload")
async def upload(files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    return {"count": len(files)}
Description
Since FastAPI 0.129.1 (PR #14953), UploadFile fields generate contentMediaType: "application/octet-stream" instead of format: "binary" in the OpenAPI schema. Swagger UI 5.x (bundled with FastAPI via CDN @5) does not render a file picker for contentMediaType — it shows a text input instead.

Operating System
macOS
Operating System Details
No response
FastAPI Version
0.131.0
Pydantic Version
2.12.5
Python Version
3.14.2
Additional Context
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/upload")
async def upload(files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    return {"count": len(files)}


Run uvicorn app:app
Open /docs
The files field shows a text input, not a "Choose File" button

Expected behavior
Swagger UI should show a file picker widget.
Root cause

FastAPI 0.129.1+ generates: {"type": "string", "contentMediaType": "application/octet-stream"}
FastAPI 0.128.x generated: {"type": "string", "format": "binary"}
Swagger UI 5.x only renders file pickers for format: "binary" (see swagger-api/swagger-ui#9278)

Workaround
Post-process the OpenAPI schema in custom_openapi():
def _fix_file_upload_schemas(schema: dict) -> None:
    for component in schema.get("components", {}).get("schemas", {}).values():
        for prop in component.get("properties", {}).values():
            if prop.get("contentMediaType") == "application/octet-stream":
                del prop["contentMediaType"]
                prop["format"] = "binary"
            items = prop.get("items", {})
            if items.get("contentMediaType") == "application/octet-stream":
                del items["contentMediaType"]
                items["format"] = "binary"

answer.body:
Hello!

You can try this workaround until this is fixed:

```python3
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile as UF, File
from typing import Annotated
from pydantic import WithJsonSchema

app = FastAPI()

UploadFile = Annotated[UF, WithJsonSchema({"type": "string", "format": "binary"})]

@app.post("/upload")
async def upload(files: list[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    return {"count": len(files)}
```
